title: MePo++: Unifying Representation Refinement and Reconciliation for General Continual Learning
abstract: arXiv:2609.05075v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: General continual learning (GCL) aims to learn from evolving data streams without task identities, explicit boundaries, or repeated access to previous data, making it a realistic yet challenging setting for continual intelligence. Although pretrained models (PTMs) provide rich prior knowledge for addressing the limited supervision and non-stationary nature of GCL, existing PTM-based methods often directly adapt pretrained representations and overlook two critical gaps: the misalignment between upstream pretraining and downstream continual adaptation, and the unreliability of conventional output alignment under blurry streams. translated_title: MePo++：面向通用持续学习的表示精炼与调和统一框架
translated_abstract: arXiv:2609.05075v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：通用持续学习（GCL）旨在从不断演进的数据流中学习，且无需任务身份、显式边界或对先前数据的重复访问，这使其成为持续智能中一个现实却极具挑战性的场景。尽管预训练模型（PTM）为应对GCL中监督有限与非平稳特性提供了丰富的先验知识，但现有的基于PTM的方法往往直接适配预训练表示，忽视了两个关键差距：上游预训练与下游持续适配之间的错位，以及在模糊数据流下传统输出对齐方式的不可靠性。为此，我们提出了MePo++，一个统一的后训练框架，通过表示精炼与调和来衔接预训练知识与下游GCL任务。MePo++引入了两个互补的组件：MetaPrep，通过无监督元表示准备提升持续适配所需的表示可塑性（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出统一后训练框架MePo++，通过表示精炼（MetaPrep）与调和机制弥合预训练知识与下游通用持续学习之间的差距，同时解决预训练与持续适配的错位以及模糊数据流下输出对齐不可靠这两大关键问题。
en_tdlr: MePo++ is a unified post-training framework that bridges pretrained knowledge and downstream general continual learning through representation refinement (MetaPrep) and reconciliation, addressing both the misalignment between pretraining and continual adaptation and the unreliability of conventional output alignment under blurry data streams.
